Country: Ethiopia; domain: Housing and Socio-economic Conditions; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2019. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Out-of-pocket expenditure (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Time-series health financing metrics on out-of-pocket health expenditure in Nigeria, compiled by the World Health Organization (WHO Global Health Expenditure Database) and published on HDX, disaggregated by percentage of current health expenditure (CHE), per capita expenditure, financing scheme, and primary reference reporting year. Country: Nigeria; domain: Health and Vital Statistics; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2000-2023. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Out-of-school children (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: This dataset provides regional education statistics for Ethiopia for the 2023–2024 academic year, including gross and net enrollment ratios. It can support research on out-of-school children by helping assess school participation and identify regional gaps in access to education. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Education; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1987-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: PM2.5 (Egypt)
datasets.description: The dataset provides data for PM2.5 emissions in Egypt, tracking fine particulate matter pollution levels across localized sources and key economic sectors. Country: Egypt; domain: Climate and Environment; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2024-2026. Updated annual.

datasets.name: People affected (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: This CSV dataset contains standardized indicator data on Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) in Ethiopia, hosted on the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) via the HDX Humanitarian API (HAPI) and sourced from the International Organization for Migration (IOM) Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM). Country: Ethiopia; domain: Disaster and Hazards; geographic level: National. Updated annual.

datasets.name: People displaced (Egypt)
datasets.description: Subnational and national demographic tracking dataset on refugees, asylum seekers, and forcibly displaced populations residing in Egypt, compiled by the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) and published on HDX, disaggregated by country of origin, demographic profile (age cohort and sex), legal registration status, and primary host administrative governorate/location across reporting periods. Country: Egypt; domain: Disaster and Hazards; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1978-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: People displaced (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: This CSV dataset contains standardized indicator data on Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) in Ethiopia, hosted on the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) via the HDX Humanitarian API (HAPI) and sourced from the International Organization for Migration (IOM) Displacement Tracking Matrix (DTM). Country: Ethiopia; domain: Disaster and Hazards; geographic level: National. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Pesticide use (Kenya)
datasets.description: Total agricultural pesticide use in Kenya, measured in kilograms of active ingredient applied per hectare of cropland or as total annual tonnage at the national level. Country: Kenya; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2003-2022. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Piped water access (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: The dataset covers piped water access in Ethiopia, including household access to private and shared piped water infrastructure at the national level. The relevant indicators distinguish between household and population access to piped water. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Urban Systems and Infrastructure; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2000-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Population density (Egypt)
datasets.description: Gridded population density at a resolution of 30 arc-seconds, representing top-down modelled population density estimates per pixel for individual countries, available with or without UN 2019 population total adjustments for each year from 2000 to 2020. Country: Egypt; domain: Demographics and Population; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Population near public transport (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: The data is about Ethiopia Urban Transport for Urban Population who can access a public transport stop within a walking distance of 500 meters. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Transport and Mobility; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020-2020. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Population near public transport (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Proportion or headcount of the urban population in Nigeria living within a walkable distance, typically 500 meters to a low-capacity stop or 1,000 meters to a high-capacity station, of a public transport access point, evaluated across urban centers, states, or at the national level. Country: Nigeria; domain: Transport and Mobility; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020-01-01 - 2025-12-31. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Port throughput (Kenya)
datasets.description: The dataset provides daily information on port activities in Kenya, including preliminary estimates of shipment volumes, to support monitoring of maritime trade and cargo movement. Country: Kenya; domain: Transport and Mobility; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2019-2026. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Poverty headcount (Kenya)
datasets.description: Poverty headcount ratios for Kenya, measured as the percentage of the population living below national and international poverty lines, calculated using household survey consumption and income data. Country: Kenya; domain: Economics and Labor; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1992-2022. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Pre-primary enrollment (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: This dataset provides information on pre-primary school enrollment in Ethiopia by region for the 2023–2024 academic year . It presents gross and net enrollment ratios to assess access to early childhood education and compare enrollment levels across regions. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Education; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1974-2015. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Pre-primary enrollment (Nigeria)
datasets.description: National time-series data on gross and net pre-primary school enrollment rates in Nigeria, compiled by the World Bank (Education Statistics / EdStats) and published on HDX, disaggregated by sex, age cohort, enrollment share in private versus public institutions, and reference academic year. Country: Nigeria; domain: Education; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2001-2010. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Precipitation (Egypt)
datasets.description: The dataset provides data for precipitation in Egypt, tracking historical rainfall patterns, annual precipitation totals, and climate-related moisture trends across time. Country: Egypt; domain: Climate and Environment; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: (1960-01-01)-(2025-12-31). Updated annual.

datasets.name: Precipitation (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Precipitation in Nigeria, representing the total volume of rainfall recorded over a given period, expressed in millimeters, disaggregated by state, geopolitical zone, and ecological region. Country: Nigeria; domain: Climate and Environment; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1981-2026. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Precipitation anomaly (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Precipitation anomaly in Nigeria, representing the deviation of observed rainfall totals from a long-term historical baseline average, expressed in millimeters or percentage deviation, disaggregated by state and geopolitical zone. Country: Nigeria; domain: Climate and Environment; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1981-2026. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Primary completion (Nigeria)
datasets.description: The dataset covers primary school completion in Nigeria, with annual national-level indicator records available in a broader collection of country statistics. The relevant entries are recorded for 2000–2010, supporting analysis of changes in primary completion over that period. Country: Nigeria; domain: Education; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2000-2010. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Primary energy supply (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: Energy production, consumption, dependency, and efficiency describe national and global energy systems, including energy supply, use, reliance on different energy sources, and efficiency of consumption. The data cover countries worldwide and are compiled by the World Bank using information from the International Energy Agency and the Carbon Dioxide Information Analysis Center. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Energy; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1970-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Private equity investment (Kenya)
datasets.description: These indicators measure Kenya’s business environment, trade performance, and economic competitiveness. They cover exports and imports, tariffs, customs efficiency, logistics, electricity access, business registration, access to finance, taxation, corruption, workforce training, and women’s participation in business ownership. They also assess technology exports, tourism, financial services, infrastructure investment, and regulatory burdens affecting business growth and private-sector development. Country: Kenya; domain: Business and Firm Dynamics; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1960-2024.

datasets.name: Producer price index (Egypt)
datasets.description: Agricultural producer prices represent the prices farmers receive for primary crops, live animals, and primary livestock products at the farm gate or first point of sale. The agricultural producer price index measures the average change over time in these prices, with annual data available from 1991 and monthly data from January 2010 for Egypt. Country: Egypt; domain: Economics and Labor; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1991-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Protected area coverage (Egypt)
datasets.description: Protected area coverage (WDPCA), Egypt, measuring the percentage and spatial extent of terrestrial and marine areas officially protected or conserved relative to total national area, compiled by UNEP-WCMC on HDX. Country: Egypt; domain: Biodiversity and Ecosystems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1981-2012. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Protected area tourism visits (Kenya)
datasets.description: Protected area tourism refers to visitation across Kenya’s national parks, national reserves, marine parks, and sanctuaries managed by the Kenya Wildlife Service (KWS) alongside county governments and private/community conservancies. Wildlife and nature-based tourism remain the primary driver of Kenya's tourism economy. Country: Kenya; domain: Tourism; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1964 - 2005. Updated monthly.

datasets.name: Public infrastructure investment (Kenya)
datasets.description: Public infrastructure investment, Kenya, tracking government and World Bank-supported capital expenditures toward the construction, rehabilitation, and development of public infrastructure facilities at the national level. Country: Kenya; domain: Urban Systems and Infrastructure; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1960-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Public transport access (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: Subnational urban transport accessibility metrics for Ethiopia aligned with Sustainable Development Goal 11.2.1, compiled by UN-Habitat Data and Analytics Section and published on HDX, tracking the estimated proportion of the urban population with convenient access to public transport stops within walking distance (500m for low-capacity systems and 1,000m for high-capacity systems), disaggregated by sex, age group, and persons with disabilities. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Urban Systems and Infrastructure; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Public transport access (Nigeria)
datasets.description: This dataset provides information on access to public transport in Nigeria, including the availability and accessibility of public transportation services. It supports the assessment of transport accessibility and helps identify gaps in public transport infrastructure and services. Country: Nigeria; domain: Urban Systems and Infrastructure; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Refugee population (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: The Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open platform managed by UN OCHA, aggregates thousands of forced displacement datasets primarily sourced from UNHCR, national authorities, and international NGOs. These open-access datasets provide vital, up-to-date demographic statistics on refugees, asylum-seekers, and internally displaced persons, including age, gender, geographic location, household vulnerability, and access to basic services like water and shelter. Aid agencies, researchers, and policymakers rely on HDX's central repository to monitor evolving crisis trends, analyze living conditions, and coordinate life-saving relief efforts effectively worldwide. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Migration, Refugees and Displacement; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1967-1974. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Refugee population (Kenya)
datasets.description: Official counts of registered refugees and asylum seekers residing in Kenya, compiled by the Refugee Affairs Secretariat and disaggregated by demographic indicators including age brackets and sex. Country: Kenya; domain: Migration, Refugees and Displacement; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2014-2018. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Road density (Nigeria)
datasets.description: The dataset provides infrastructure-related indicators for Nigeria, supporting analysis of electricity access, telecommunications, water supply, and sanitation. Country: Nigeria; domain: Urban Systems and Infrastructure; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1960-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Road traffic mortality (Kenya)
datasets.description: The dataset contains records of road traffic accidents in Kenya, including accident-related information for analyzing road safety incidents. It covers national-level records with geographic granularity limited to the scope documented in the available data. Country: Kenya; domain: Health and Vital Statistics; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2016-2017. Updated annual.

datasets.name: School attendance (Kenya)
datasets.description: School attendance across Kenya's counties for the population aged 3 years and above—as captured by the national census data—reveals a high concentration of individuals currently enrolled during early childhood and school-going age groups driven by primary and secondary education frameworks, which sharply transitions post-adolescence into the "Attended in the Past" or "Never Attended" categories as individuals exit formal education, while simultaneously exposing distinct geographical and gender-based disparities where certain regions experience pronounced barriers resulting in elevated out-of-school and never-attended rates compared to the national average. Country: Kenya; domain: Education; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2019 - 2019. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Secondary enrollment (Nigeria)
datasets.description: The dataset covers secondary and tertiary enrollment in Nigeria, with annual national-level indicator records available in a broader collection of education statistics. The records support analysis of enrollment trends across both education levels. Country: Nigeria; domain: Education; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1970-2016. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Slum population (Egypt)
datasets.description: Slum population dataset provides data on the population living in slum conditions in Egypt, helping researchers examine urban housing challenges, access to basic services, and living conditions. It supports analysis of urban poverty and progress toward improving housing and sanitation in the country. Country: Egypt; domain: Urban Systems and Infrastructure; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2000-2022. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Slum population (Nigeria)
datasets.description: The dataset provides indicators on income inequality, income distribution, and multidimensional poverty, including income shares across population groups and the extent and intensity of poverty. Country: Nigeria; domain: Urban Systems and Infrastructure; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1985-2022. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Social assistance coverage (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Social assistance coverage in Nigeria, defined as the percentage of poor and vulnerable households registered in the National Social Register receiving non-contributory cash transfers or shock-responsive safety net benefits, disaggregated across national, state, and local government areas. Country: Nigeria; domain: Disability and Social Protection; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1986-2018. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Social protection coverage (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: The dataset provides data for social protection coverage in Ethiopia, tracking safety net participation, social assistance programs, and labor market indicators across vulnerable populations. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Housing and Socio-economic Conditions; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1981-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Social protection coverage (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Social protection coverage in Nigeria, defined as the combined rate of formal-sector workers enrolled in social security and informal-economy households accessing basic social safety net programs, reported annually across state and local government area administrative divisions. Country: Nigeria; domain: Disability and Social Protection; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2010-2018. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Social protection expenditure (Egypt)
datasets.description: Social protection expenditure refers to the total financial resources allocated by public and private entities to fund policies and programs designed to reduce poverty, manage economic risks, and cushion individuals against life-cycle vulnerabilities. Country: Egypt; domain: Disability and Social Protection; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1960-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: TB incidence (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: The estimated number of new and relapse cases of tuberculosis (TB) occurring in a population during a given year, expressed as the rate per 100,000 population. It includes all forms of TB, including cases among people living with HIV. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Health and Vital Statistics; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1995-2024.

datasets.name: Tertiary attainment (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: The dataset provides information on the level of educational attainment in tertiary education, such as the proportion of the population that has completed university or other higher education programmes. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Education; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1971-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Tourism expenditure (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Provides information on spending associated with tourism in Nigeria, supporting analysis of tourism-related economic activity and expenditure trends over time. Country: Nigeria; domain: Tourism; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1995-2020. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Tourism receipts (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Measures the revenue generated in Nigeria from international visitors’ spending on goods and services during their trips, generally expressed in current US dollars. It supports analysis of international tourism earnings and their contribution to the country’s economy over time. Country: Nigeria; domain: Tourism; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1960-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Under-5 mortality (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: Under-5 mortality rate in Ethopia, defined as the probability of a child born in a specified reference period dying before reaching exactly five years of age, expressed as deaths per 1,000 live births across national, state, and district levels. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Health and Vital Statistics; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2011-2021. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Universal health coverage index (Kenya)
datasets.description: Universal health coverage service coverage index in Kenya, representing the average coverage of essential health services calculated on a scale from 0 to 100 based on tracer indicators across reproductive, maternal, newborn, and child health, infectious diseases, non-communicable diseases, and service capacity, reported at the national level. Country: Kenya; domain: Health and Vital Statistics; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1997-2023.

datasets.name: Universal health coverage index (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Time-series estimates tracking Nigeria's Universal Health Coverage (UHC) service coverage index (SDG 3.8.1) and essential health service capacity metrics, compiled by the World Health Organization and published on HDX, disaggregated by service tracer domain (reproductive, maternal, newborn, and child health; infectious diseases; non-communicable diseases; service capacity and access) and primary reference reporting year. Country: Nigeria; domain: Health and Vital Statistics; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1963-2024. Updated monthly.

datasets.name: Urban accessibility (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: The data is about Ethiopia Urban Transport for Urban Population who can access a public transport stop within a walking distance of 500 meters. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Transport and Mobility; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020-2020. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Urban density (Egypt)
datasets.description: Access to electricity, Mortality caused by road traffic injury, Motor vehicles, PM2.5 air pollution, Passenger cars, Population density, Population in largest city, Population in the largest city, Population in urban agglomerations of more than 1 million, Population living in slums, Urban land area,. Country: Egypt; domain: Urban Systems and Infrastructure; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1960-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Urban density (Kenya)
datasets.description: For Urban density, high-resolution gridded tables splitting macro-population metrics down to clean 1km structural grid units across Kenya. Country: Kenya; domain: Urban Systems and Infrastructure; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2000 – 2020.

datasets.name: Urban density (Nigeria)
datasets.description: The dataset tracks urban land consumption, population growth, land-use efficiency, and built-up area per capita over time. Country: Nigeria; domain: Urban Systems and Infrastructure; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2000-2020. Updated decenially.

datasets.name: Urban expansion (Nigeria)
datasets.description: The dataset covers urbanization, population trends, transport, electricity access, air pollution, road safety, and urban land use. Country: Nigeria; domain: Urban Systems and Infrastructure; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1960-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Water stress (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Based on the World Bank environment indicators for Nigeria provided on HDX, Level of water stress measures the total fresh water withdrawn by all major sectors (agriculture, industry, and municipal services) as a percentage of the total renewable freshwater resources available in the country. This metric highlights the pressure placed on a nation's internal freshwater supply, where a higher percentage indicates greater vulnerability to water scarcity and increased competition among competing user sectors. Country: Nigeria; domain: Climate and Environment; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1987-2022. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Women in managerial positions (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: National time-series data tracking the proportion of women in managerial positions in Ethiopia, compiled by the World Bank (Gender Statistics / World Development Indicators) and published on HDX, disaggregated by female share of middle and senior management roles, firm ownership/leadership status, sector, and reference reporting year. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Gender and Social Inclusion; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2006-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: 5G coverage (Kenya)
datasets.description: Number of the population or geographic land area covered by a commercial 5G mobile cellular network in Kenya, measured nationally. Country: Kenya; domain: Digital Economy, ICT and AI; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2018-2022. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Agricultural productivity (Kenya)
datasets.description: The Kenya agricultural productivity dataset provides national-level statistics on crop production, cultivated area, and yields, measuring agricultural output and productivity. Country: Kenya; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2015-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Agriculture employment (Kenya)
datasets.description: The Kenya agricultural employment dataset provides national statistics on wage employment in agriculture, forestry, and fishing. Country: Kenya; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Agriculture exports (Kenya)
datasets.description: The Kenya agricultural exports dataset provides national statistics on the quantities and values of exported agricultural products. Country: Kenya; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Agriculture imports (Kenya)
datasets.description: The Kenya agricultural imports dataset provides national statistics on the quantities and values of imported agricultural products and inputs. Country: Kenya; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Agriculture value added (Kenya)
datasets.description: The Kenya agricultural value added dataset provides national statistics on agricultural output, consumption, and gross value added, showing agriculture’s contribution to Kenya’s economy. Country: Kenya; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2016-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Air passenger traffic (Kenya)
datasets.description: The dataset provides commercial air passenger traffic by airport in Kenya from 2015 to 2024, including domestic and international passengers, arrivals, departures, and transit passengers. Country: Kenya; domain: Transport and Mobility; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2015-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Assault (Kenya)
datasets.description: The Kenya assault statistics dataset provides national-level data on assault cases reported to the police and persons reported to have committed assault offences, supporting analysis of crime trends and public safety. Country: Kenya; domain: Crime and Justice; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2018-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Average broadband speed (Kenya)
datasets.description: Dataset provides information on average broadband internet speed and connectivity performance in Kenya, covering fixed and wireless broadband services at the national level. Country: Kenya; domain: Digital Economy, ICT and AI; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2019-2022. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Average earnings (Kenya)
datasets.description: Average annual earnings per employee in Kenya's public sector across major economic activities and public institutions, measured in Kenyan Shillings (KSh) at the national level. Country: Kenya; domain: Economics and Labor; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2015-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Average household size (Kenya)
datasets.description: Average household size in Kenya, calculated as the total population living in conventional private households divided by the total number of enumerated households, measured at the national, county, and sub-county levels during decennial population censuses. Country: Kenya; domain: Demographics and Population; geographic level: National, County. Temporal coverage: 2019. Updated decennial.

datasets.name: Building permits (Kenya)
datasets.description: The Building Permits in Kenya dataset, published by the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS), provides information on building-plan applications received and approved in 2022 and 2023. It covers different building types, including residential, commercial and mixed-use buildings, and supports analysis of construction activity and housing development in Kenya. Country: Kenya; domain: Housing and Socio-economic Conditions; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2022-2023. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Burglary (Kenya)
datasets.description: The Kenya Crime Statistics provide national data on reported offences, including burglary and breakings, robbery, theft, and offences against persons and offenders categorized by sex across Kenya. Country: Kenya; domain: Crime and Justice; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Cereal production (Kenya)
datasets.description: Cereal production in Kenya, defined as annual and seasonal total output in metric tons, harvested area in hectares, and average yields for major grain crops (including maize, wheat, rice, sorghum, and millet) harvested for dry grain only, compiled at national and county levels based on Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS) and Ministry of Agriculture reports. Country: Kenya; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2016-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Cereal production (Kenya)
datasets.description: Cereal production in Kenya, defined as annual and seasonal total output in metric tons, harvested area in hectares, and average yields for major grain crops (including maize, wheat, rice, sorghum, and millet) harvested for dry grain only, compiled at national and county levels based on Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS) and Ministry of Agriculture reports. Country: Kenya; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2015-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Consumer price index (Kenya)
datasets.description: This dataset measures changes in the retail prices of a representative basket of consumer goods and services over time, serving as a primary economic indicator to track inflation rates and shifts in household purchasing power. Country: Kenya; domain: Economics and Labor; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2019-01 - 2026-07. Updated monthly.

datasets.name: Control of corruption (Kenya)
datasets.description: The dataset covers corruption-related administrative indicators in Kenya, including reports received for investigation, case files forwarded for prosecution, and the monetary value of public assets traced or recovered. It contains annual national-level records spanning 2013 to 2025, with no sub-national geographic disaggregation specified in the available metadata. Country: Kenya; domain: Governance and Public Institutions; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2013-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Conviction rate (Kenya)
datasets.description: The Kenya Judicial and Penal Statistics provide national data on conviction rates across law enforcement and court systems, with supporting metrics covering total prisoners, convicted prisoners, and unconvicted prisoners awaiting trial. Country: Kenya; domain: Crime and Justice; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Court cases (Kenya)
datasets.description: The Kenya Judicial Statistics provide national data on court cases filed, disposed of, and pending across various court levels in Kenya. Country: Kenya; domain: Crime and Justice; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2019-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Criminal cases disposed (Kenya)
datasets.description: Criminal cases disposed in Kenya, representing the total number of criminal matters concluded or resolved through judgment, acquittal, dismissal, plea bargain, or withdrawal within a given financial year, disaggregated by court level (such as Magistrates' Courts or High Court), county, and method of disposition. Country: Kenya; domain: Justice, Prisons and Human Trafficking; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2016-2023. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Criminal cases filed (Kenya)
datasets.description: Criminal cases filed in Kenya, representing the total number of new formal criminal proceedings registered across all court levels during a given financial year, disaggregated by court type (such as Magistrates' Courts, High Court, or specialized tribunals), offense category, and county. Country: Kenya; domain: Justice, Prisons and Human Trafficking; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2016-2023. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Crop production (Kenya)
datasets.description: Crop production in Kenya, representing annual and seasonal total output, harvested area, and crop yields for major food staples (maize, wheat, rice, sorghum) and commercial cash crops (tea, coffee, sugarcane, horticulture) evaluated at the national, county, and sub-county levels. Country: Kenya; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2023-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Crude birth rate (Kenya)
datasets.description: The crude birth rate in Kenya represents the annual number of live births per 1,000 people in the mid-year population, with data presented nationally and by county for 2018–2024. The dataset supports analysis of birth-rate trends across counties and over time. Country: Kenya; domain: Demographics and Population; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2019. Updated decennial.

datasets.name: Crude death rate (Kenya)
datasets.description: This dataset provides national and sub-national statistics on the crude death rate in Kenya, published by the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics via the Kenya Open Data portal. Sourced from the Socio-Economic Data of Kenya (SEDK) surveys, it tracks annual mortality rates per 1,000 individuals to support public health monitoring, demographic analysis, and social policy development. Country: Kenya; domain: Demographics and Population; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1979-1989. Updated biennial.

datasets.name: Data traffic (Kenya)
datasets.description: The dataset provides information on data traffic in Kenya, covering national-level telecommunications indicators related to data transmission and ICT usage. Country: Kenya; domain: Digital Economy, ICT and AI; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020-2022. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Disability prevalence (Kenya)
datasets.description: Demographic, socioeconomic, household, housing and population statistics for Kenya. It includes population distribution, age, sex, disability, education, employment, household characteristics and other indicators. Country: Kenya; domain: Housing and Socio-economic Conditions; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2007-2007. Updated annaul.

datasets.name: Drug trafficking (Kenya)
datasets.description: The Kenya Drug Offences Statistics provide national data on reported dangerous drug offences, including possession, trafficking, and cultivation of dangerous drugs and offenders. Country: Kenya; domain: Crime and Justice; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Education expenditure per student (Kenya)
datasets.description: Government expenditure per student at both primary and secondary education level in Kenya, expressed as a percentage of GDP per capita. It reflects average public spending per primary and secondary student relative to national economic output per person. Country: Kenya; domain: Education; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2015-2026. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Electricity access (Kenya)
datasets.description: The Electricity Access in Kenya dataset, published by the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS), provides information on the proportion of households connected to the main electricity grid. It includes national, urban, rural and county-level statistics, supporting analysis of electrification, infrastructure development and household access to electricity across Kenya. Country: Kenya; domain: Housing and Socio-economic Conditions; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2023-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Employment (Kenya)

When expanding to include all greenhouse gases (such as methane and nitrous oxide) alongside land-use changes, the broader footprint reaches roughly 1.7 tonnes of $\text{CO}_2\text{e}$ per person. Because Nigeria’s total national emissions (136 million tonnes of fossil $\text{CO}_2$ in 2024) are distributed across a population exceeding 200 million people, its per capita footprint remains small—accounting for just 0.35% of annual global emissions. Country: Nigeria; domain: Climate and Environment; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1915-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Creative imports (Egypt)

datasets.name: Electricity generation (Egypt)

datasets.name: Energy imports (Egypt)
datasets.description: Annual electricity trade balances, net imports, exports, and consumption figures across Egypt spanning 1980 to 2012 compiled by AfDB from national grid utility statistics. datasets.name: Film production (Egypt)
datasets.description: This data displays how film production in Egypt between 2010 and 2011 served as a powerful economic and cultural driver within the Creative Economy, generating intellectual property, employment, and cross-industry growth. Country: Egypt; domain: Culture and Creative Economy; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2010-2011. Updated annual.

datasets.name: International tourist arrivals (Egypt)
datasets.description: This dataset provides information on the number of international tourist arrivals in the country from 2009 to 2012. Country: Egypt; domain: Tourism; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2011-2014. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Music industry output (Egypt)
datasets.description: The dataset presents music industry output in Egypt between 2010 and 2011 which served as a key creative and economic sector within the Culture and Creative Economy, generating revenue through live performances, recordings, and broadcasting. Country: Egypt; domain: Culture and Creative Economy; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2010-2011. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Primary energy supply (Egypt)
datasets.description: Historical time-series tracking annual crude oil production, imports, exports, and total domestic primary energy supply balances across Egypt from 1980 to 2013 via AfDB. Country: Egypt; domain: Energy; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1980-2013. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Tourism departures (Egypt)

datasets.name: Urban population growth (Egypt)

datasets.name: Juvenile prisoners (Nigeria)

datasets.name: Migration by destination (Nigeria)

datasets.name: Migration by origin (Nigeria)

datasets.name: Pre-trial detainees (Nigeria)

datasets.name: Prison occupancy (Nigeria)
datasets.description: This indicator measures facility utilization and overcrowding by comparing the actual inmate population against the official design capacity of correctional facilities, expressed as a percentage or total count variance. datasets.name: Prison population (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Data on the prison population in Nigeria, including the number of inmates by state and year and prison capacity. The data helps monitor changes in prison population over time, assess prison overcrowding, and understand the number of people held in detention while awaiting sentencing. Country: Nigeria; domain: Crime and Justice; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2013-2016. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Prison population (Nigeria)
datasets.description: This indicator measures the total number of people held in correctional facilities within a specified geographical area. Country: Nigeria; domain: Justice, Prisons and Human Trafficking; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2013-2016. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Prison population rate (Nigeria)
datasets.description: This indicator measures the number of prisoners relative to the total population, usually expressed as prisoners per 100,000 residents. It provides a standardized measure for comparing prison population levels across geographical areas and over time. Country: Nigeria; domain: Justice, Prisons and Human Trafficking; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2013-2016. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Remittances received (Nigeria)
datasets.description: The Nigeria National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) Remittances Received dataset provides survey data on money received from individuals living abroad or elsewhere, supporting analysis of remittance inflows to Nigerian households. Country: Nigeria; domain: Migration, Refugees and Displacement; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2018-2019. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Average earnings (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Average earnings in Nigeria, measuring the mean or median gross income earned by employed individuals across formal and informal sectors over a specified period, calculated using National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) labor force and household survey data to evaluate living standards, wage growth, purchasing power, and income distribution across industries. Country: Nigeria; domain: Economics and Labor; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2011-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Employment (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Employment in Nigeria, measuring the total count or proportion of the working-age population actively engaged in formal or informal gainful economic activity, calculated using National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) labor force survey methodologies to evaluate labor utilization, informal sector dominance, job creation capacity, and national economic stability. Country: Nigeria; domain: Economics and Labor; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2019-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Female labor force participation (Kenya)

datasets.name: Informal employment (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Informal employment in Nigeria, measuring the proportion of employed individuals working in jobs lacking formal contracts, social protection, or statutory benefits—spanning informal enterprises and unrecorded labor—calculated using National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) surveys following International Labour Organization (ILO) standards to evaluate labor market precariousness and economic vulnerability. datasets.name: Labor force participation rate (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Labor force participation rate in Nigeria, measuring the proportion of the working-age population (aged 15 and above) that is economically active—comprising both employed individuals and those actively seeking employment—calculated using National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) survey data to assess overall labor availability and economic engagement. Country: Nigeria; domain: Economics and Labor; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2019-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Minimum wage (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Minimum wage in Nigeria, measuring the legally mandated lowest monthly remuneration employers in formal public and private sectors must pay covered workers, established under the National Minimum Wage Act and monitored by the Federal Ministry of Labour and Employment alongside state labor administrations to guarantee baseline income floor, mitigate working poverty, and protect wage standards. datasets.name: NEET rate (Nigeria)
datasets.description: NEET rate in Nigeria, measuring the percentage of youth (typically aged 15–24 or 15–34) who are Not in Employment, Education, or Training, calculated using National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) labor force survey data to evaluate youth disengagement, educational gaps, labor market exclusion, and broader socioeconomic vulnerability. Country: Nigeria; domain: Economics and Labor; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2019-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Unemployment benefit coverage (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Population covered by unemployment protection in Nigeria, evaluated as the total number or proportion of formal sector workers enrolled in contributory social security schemes eligible to claim income-loss cash transfers upon involuntary job termination, disaggregated by state, sector, age, and sex. datasets.name: Unemployment rate (Nigeria)

datasets.name: Youth unemployment rate (Nigeria)

Country: Nigeria; domain: Economics and Labor; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2019-2024. Updated annual.

It reflects public spending across all levels of education, including current, capital, and transfer expenditures funded at national levels. Country: Kenya; domain: Education; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1971-2023. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Wastewater treatment (Kenya)
datasets.description: Proportion of wastewater generated by households and industrial facilities in Kenya that is safely treated prior to discharge or reuse, measured as a percentage (%) of total wastewater flow at the national level and disaggregated by source and sanitation system. Country: Kenya; domain: Climate and Environment; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2017-2022. Updated annual.

sources.name: National Information Platform for Food Security and Nutrition

datasets.name: Maize production (Kenya)
datasets.description: Maize production in Kenya, defined as annual total harvest output measured in 90 kg bags or metric tons, cultivated area in hectares, and average yield per hectare, reported at national and county levels based on official Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS) and Ministry of Agriculture datasets hosted on the National Information Platform for Food Security and Nutrition (NIPFN). Country: Kenya; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2012-2020. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Wildlife crime (Kenya)
datasets.description: The Kenya Wildlife Crime Prosecution Dataset provides national data on prosecuted wildlife offences, including illegal grazing, trophy possession, bushmeat crimes, and poaching, alongside offender profiles, conviction rates, and sentencing outcomes. Country: Kenya; domain: Crime and Justice; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2018–2019. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Passenger transport volume (Kenya)
datasets.description: A Kenya transport-energy dataset covering transport technologies, energy demand, and related policies, compiled by the Climate Compatible Growth programme from government and international sources to support transport-energy analysis and decarbonisation research. Validated in March–April 2022. Country: Kenya; domain: Transport and Mobility; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2015-2021. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Commute time (Kenya)
datasets.description: The amount of time a person spends travelling between their home and their usual place of work, typically measured in minutes for a one-way journey. Country: Kenya; domain: Transport and Mobility; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2015-2016. Updated annual.

datasets.name: People displaced (Kenya)
datasets.description: People displaced in Kenya, defined as the total number of internally displaced individuals remaining in temporary shelters, host communities, or informal settlements on a specific date, aggregated across national and municipal jurisdictions. Country: Kenya; domain: Disaster and Hazards; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2008-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Disaster injuries (Kenya)
datasets.description: Disaster injuries in Kenya, evaluated by combining reported emergency medical admissions and field-treated casualties resulting from qualifying hazard occurrences, aggregated across national, provincial, and municipal healthcare monitoring networks. Country: Kenya; domain: Disaster and Hazards; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1997-2026.

datasets.name: Tax revenue (Kenya)
datasets.description: The dataset covers key tax revenue drivers in Kenya, including annual collections associated with tax amnesties, debt recovery, dispute resolution, betting taxes, and other tax administration measures. It contains national-level annual revenue amounts expressed in billions of Kenyan shillings for 2023–2024. Country: Kenya; domain: Governance and Public Institutions; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2023-2024. Updated annual.

sources.name: Kenya Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Data Platform (hosted by the Kenya National Bureau of Statistics (KNBS)

datasets.name: Wastewater treatment (Kenya)
datasets.description: Proportion of domestic and industrial wastewater flows safely treated in Kenya, expressed as a percentage under Sustainable Development Goal 6. It measures the volume of wastewater receiving treatment before discharge relative to total generated flows, tracked at the national level. Country: Kenya; domain: Urban Systems and Infrastructure; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2020-2022. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Broadband coverage (Kenya)
datasets.description: ICT prices dashboard, Kenya, tracking the national costs and affordability of standardized information and communication technology services, including mobile broadband, fixed broadband, and mobile voice and data baskets, collected via annual ITU questionnaires. Country: Kenya; domain: Urban Systems and Infrastructure; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2018-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Labor force participation of persons with disabilities (Kenya)
datasets.description: This dataset from the International Labour Organization (ILO) provides statistics on Kenya’s working-age population by sex and age from 2011 to 2021. The data is available in CSV format for download and analysis. Country: Kenya; domain: Disability and Social Protection; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2016-2019. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Food insecurity (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Prevalence of moderate or severe food insecurity in Nigeria, representing the estimated proportion of the population lacking consistent access to adequate and nutritious food measured via the Food Insecurity Experience Scale, disaggregated by state, geopolitical zone, and urban-rural location. Country: Nigeria; domain: Housing and Socio-economic Conditions; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2026-2026. Updated monthly.

datasets.name: Nitrous oxide emissions (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Nigeria’s anthropogenic nitrous oxide emissions reached approximately 42.1 megatonnes equivalent in 2024. Agriculture is by far the dominant source, accounting for 70.8% of the total due to heavy synthetic fertilizer use and manure management. The remaining emissions stem from energy combustion (14.3%), other uncategorized sources (9.5%), and waste management such as wastewater treatment and landfills (5.4%), all of which have experienced steady long-term growth. Country: Nigeria; domain: Climate and Environment; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1851-2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Undernourishment (Nigeria)
datasets.description: The Prevalence of Undernourishment dataset provides national-level estimates of the percentage of Nigeria’s population consuming insufficient dietary energy, published by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). Country: Nigeria; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2023-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Passenger transport volume (Nigeria)
datasets.description: This dataset provides railway transport statistics for Nigeria for the fourth quarter of 2023. Published by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS), it contains information on railway passenger traffic, freight or goods movement, and other railway transport activities. Country: Nigeria; domain: Transport and Mobility; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: Q4 2023. Updated quaterly.

datasets.name: People displaced (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Total headcount or estimate of internally displaced persons living within Nigeria due to armed conflict, communal violence, localized crime, or natural disasters, tracked at the national and subnational level (such as states and local government areas) across formal camps, informal settlements, and host communities. Country: Nigeria; domain: Disaster and Hazards; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2008-2025. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Government R&D expenditure (Nigeria)
datasets.description: The dataset from the 2000 to 2025 shows the governmant expenditure divided by government spending, expressed as a percentage. Includes military and civil personnel, operation and maintenance, procurement, military research and development, infrastructure, and aid. Country: Nigeria; domain: Science, Research and Development and Innovation; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2000-2025.
datasets.domain: Science, Research and Development and Innovation

datasets.name: Fixed broadband subscriptions (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Fixed broadband subscriptions (%) serve as a key economic indicator for Nigeria, offering insights into structural growth, policy impacts, and digital transformation. Sourced from the ITU and updated on EconDash, tracking this metric helps analysts, researchers, and policymakers evaluate long-term trends, benchmark against peer economies, and support evidence-based decision-making. Country: Nigeria; domain: Digital Economy, ICT and AI; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2005 - 2024. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Red List Index (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Inventory of coastal plant and animal species in Nigeria, categorized by IUCN Red List status at the national level and disaggregated by species taxonomic groups across the region. Country: Nigeria; domain: Biodiversity and Ecosystems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2023-2026. Updated monthly.

datasets.name: Protected area coverage (Nigeria)
datasets.description: Total land area in Nigeria officially designated as protected reserves, national parks, or wildlife sanctuaries, calculated in square kilometers at the national level and disaggregated by site. Country: Nigeria; domain: Biodiversity and Ecosystems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1916-2008. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Tourism value added (Nigeria)
datasets.description: The dataset measures the contribution of tourism to Nigeria's economy through tourism direct gross domestic product (GDP), expressed as a percentage of total GDP and its growth rate. The data are published by Nigeria's National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) under Sustainable Development Goal indicator 8.9.1 and cover the national level. Country: Nigeria; domain: Tourism; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2016-2023. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Electricity capacity (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: Energy access in Ethiopia reflects progress in electricity access, which increased from 29% of the population in 2015 to 55.4% in 2023, with access rates of 94.7% in urban areas and 43.6% in rural areas. In 2023, installed energy capacity reached 5,669 MW, while per-capita electricity consumption was 97 kWh. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Energy; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2015-2023. Updated annual.

sources.name: food and agriculture organization of the united nation

datasets.name: Irrigated area (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: Area equipped for irrigation (AEI) in Ethiopia, representing total national and regional land area with irrigation infrastructure in 2001, evaluated at the state and district levels and derived from official ministry reports and scheme inventories. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Dietary diversity (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: This dataset provides information on dietary diversity in Ethiopia by measuring the variety of food groups consumed by individuals or households. It helps assess diet quality, nutritional adequacy, and food security, highlighting access to diverse and nutritious foods in Ethiopia. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2023. Updated monthly.

datasets.name: Wasting (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: This dataset provides data on the prevalence of wasting among children under five, helping monitor acute malnutrition and child health in Ethiopia. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2023-2026. Updated monthly.

datasets.name: Government effectiveness (Ethiopia)
datasets.description: Quality of public services, the independence and capacity of the civil service, policy formulation and implementation, and the credibility of government commitments in Ethiopia, measured at the national level using World Bank Worldwide Governance Indicators standardized scale units ranging from -2.5 to +2.5. Country: Ethiopia; domain: Crime and Justice; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2002-2026. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Household count (Egypt)
datasets.description: Household count is the total number of primary social units comprising one or more individuals who live together in the same housing unit and share common housekeeping arrangements, enumerated across national, state, and district administrative levels. Country: Egypt; domain: Demographics and Population; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1992-1992. Updated annual.

datasets.name: GNI (Egypt)
datasets.description: Gross National Income (GNI) is defined as the total value created by resident institutional units plus net primary income received from non-resident units, comprising employee compensation and property income, measured across national administrative levels. Country: Egypt; domain: Economics and Labor; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1965-2023. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Agriculture imports (Egypt)
datasets.description: Total monetary value and physical volume of raw agricultural commodities, including grains, oilseeds, livestock, and raw plant products, imported into Egypt from international markets, tracked by the Central Agency for Public Mobilization and Statistics (CAPMAS), the General Authority for Supply Commodities (GASC), and the Egyptian Agricultural Quarantine across product types, origin countries, and import channels. Country: Egypt; domain: Agriculture and Food Systems; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2015-2022. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Burglary (Egypt)
datasets.description: Reported unlawful entries into premises to commit theft per 100,000 population, tracked by the Ministry of Interior, CAPMAS, and UNODC, disaggregated by property type and governorate. Country: Egypt; domain: Crime and Justice; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2006-2011. Updated annual.

datasets.name: People affected (Egypt)
datasets.description: Cross-country interactive dataset on natural disaster impacts and frequency compiled by Our World in Data (derived from the EM-DAT / Centre for Research on the Epidemiology of Disasters database), tracking global and national time-series metrics on disaster occurrence rates, direct economic losses, displaced populations, and annual death tolls disaggregated by disaster category (hydrological, meteorological, climatological, and geophysical). Country: Egypt; domain: Disaster and Hazards; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1980-2023. Updated biennial.

datasets.name: Migrant inflows (Egypt)
datasets.description: Data provides a historical overview of Egypt’s international migrant stock from 1990 to 2020, tracking the steady growth of both male and female foreign-born populations residing in the country over three decades. Country: Egypt; domain: Migration, Refugees and Displacement; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1977-2017. Updated annual.

datasets.name: Remittances received (Egypt)
datasets.description: The dataset covers remittances received by Egypt, recorded within balance of payments and external debt statistics. It contains national-level records available for 2004–2016, with quarterly and annual reporting. Country: Egypt; domain: Migration, Refugees and Displacement; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2004-2016. Updated quaterly and annually.

datasets.name: Refugee population (Egypt)
datasets.description: The dataset covers refugees and asylum seekers in Egypt, with population figures classified by country of origin. It contains national-level records for September 2026, with no confirmed regular update frequency. Country: Egypt; domain: Migration, Refugees and Displacement; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 2026. Updated irregular.

datasets.name: Government debt (Egypt)
datasets.description: This metric reflects the total nominal gross financial liabilities of Egypt's general government sector (combining central, regional, and local government obligations) evaluated against the country's total economic output for the year. Country: Egypt; domain: Governance and Public Institutions; geographic level: National. Temporal coverage: 1980-2031. Updated annual.
